title: Fix topbar stats chips: label ambiguity and redundant subtitle labels
goal: The topbar stats chip row shows labels like '4 ENGAGEMENTS · DOSSIERS · 4 RUNS · MISSIONS · 5 FINDINGS · 4 CRITICAL · 5 OPEN ITEMS · BASELINE'. Several problems: (1) 'ENGAGEMENTS · DOSSIERS' reads as two separate counts but is one number — the '· DOSSIERS' suffix is redundant; simplify to '4 Engagements', (2) 'RUNS · MISSIONS' — same issue; simplify to '4 Runs', (3) 'OPEN ITEMS · BASELINE' — unclear what BASELINE means here; remove the baseline suffix or show it as a separate badge only when a baseline comparison is active, (4) Chip font size and contrast may be too small to read at a glance — verify minimum 11px and adequate contrast against the dark topbar background. Update the chip rendering logic in app.js renderTopbarStats or equivalent function.
scope: System review 2026-05-01: Topbar stats chips show concatenated labels ('ENGAGEMENTS · DOSSIERS', 'RUNS · MISSIONS', 'OPEN ITEMS · BASELINE') that are confusing. The middle terms appear to be secondary descriptor words appended to counts but add no value and create parsing difficulty.
generation_reason: System review 2026-05-01: Topbar stats chips have confusing concatenated labels — simplify to single-noun count chips.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Only update chip label strings and rendering. Do not change data fetching or topbar layout.

success_criteria: Each chip shows one count and one noun: '4 Engagements', '4 Runs', '5 Findings', '4 Critical', '5 Open'.
No chip has a mid-dot separator with a secondary descriptor word.
BASELINE chip only shows when a baseline comparison is active (or is removed entirely).
Chips are readable at 11px min font size on dark background.
